caption: The drawing depicts a wooden side table with four elongated, turned legs, each featuring decorative details near the top and tapering toward the bottom. The tabletop and frame are a reddish-brown wood, with a polished appearance and prominent wood grain. The table has two drawers at the front, with the drawer faces rendered in a lighter, golden wood tone and decorated with circular wooden knobs. Below the drawers, attached to the underside of the table, is a semicircular or crescent-shaped fabric basket, light greenish-gray in color with horizontal folds, supported on both sides by the table structure. The entire composition is contained within a single-line rectangular border on an otherwise plain, beige background.
title: Sewing Table
